# Test fixtures

`wiki_canned.json` holds real responses from the English Wikipedia API
(search + lead-section extracts), captured once on 2026-11-19 for twelve
generic questions so `test_world_facts.py` can run offline. The text is from
Wikipedia, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; each entry keeps its page title, page id,
revision id and URL as attribution. Extracts are trimmed to 2,000 characters.

Nothing in this folder came from Nicholas.
